content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the šiauliai district court the court has made a final resolution regarding the division of matrimonial property the specific details of the land plots and vehicles involved are not provided the case is governed by the civil code which includes relevant articles such as the division of shares in matrimonial property and the concept of personal property for spouses the applicant is seeking a divorce from the defendant and wants to retain their own surname they also want the defendant to pay for their legal costs the court will proceed with the case and make a decision based on the evidence presented the court must consider the interests of minor children the financial situation of each spouse and other relevant circumstances when determining the division of community property both parties have creditors involved in the case the court will allocate costs based on the conduct of the parties and the reasons for the costs incurred the applicant has chosen to waive the costs of the proceedings the court has decided to dissolve the marriage and change the surnames of the parties the property of each party will be recognized as personal property including various land plots and vehicles
